review_description: I think it all went very smoothly. It was the most expensive of the 3 quotes. But I liked the salesman he was very enthusiastic. They promised a lot of after sales support, so we will see if they deliver on that. The owner has contacted me already after the instal to set up the next step in that service. So that’s good.I have seen other peoples phone app which seems to give more detail of some of the major appliances, ie HWS, pool filters etc. mine only shows the total house consumption so a bit bummed with that.
Hott Electrics were great to deal with and I am very happy with the performance of the system

The salesperson was very knowledgeable, open and honest, understanding my needs rather than trying to sell a system. The quote was competitive. Installation was well organised and went to schedule. All logistics of getting the new system was handled well and without delay. And customer service has been prompt.

We have been very impressed with all aspects of our interactions with our solar system installer, HOTT Electrics Pty Ltd. From our first meeting in person with them to talk about the best system for our home, to the follow up to our subsequent questions, through to install day, everything was handled with professionalism. We also wanted to support HOTT Electrics as they are based in our local region but apart from this their price was competitive and service was excellent.  Highly recommend.
Hott Electrics were up front with all costs and very pleasant to deal with. Very happy with the installation.

Sales quoting process was smooth and I was confident the proposed system was suited to my circumstances.Instal was smooth without any problems.The whole process was great and without issue. Highly recommend.

Fantastic installer. Was able to configure panels with my quirky roof and 26 degree pitch. The boys were brilliant, on time, polite, always letting me know what was happening and tidy.  Got the job done in one day and the after sales service is impressive.

Very happy with the whole process, Was informative and Honest, was happy to recommend on my needs and not over sell. Very efficient and punctual with keeping to Install date, above and beyond customer service, even helped with our own wi-fi issue that wasn't their problem, and done all the forms and paperwork for grid connection on my behalf.

Outstanding professional service and workmanship. Very impressed with HOTT Electrics as a solar and full electrical panel installer. The HOTT Electrics team did an amazing 18.48kW installation on a challenging 45-degree pitched terra-cotta tiled roof. James provided expert knowledge, advice, competive pricing and excellent value propositions. The quality of the installation has exceeded our expectations.Thank you HOTT Electrics - well done :)

Recently contracted HOTT Electrics to augment our existing seven year old 4.9kW, Fronius/Trina installation. Their’s was one of four quotes obtained, and involved onsite inspection and discussion with the actual installer as opposed to remote/unseen estimates from the other three.  Answers to all our many questions with respect to this installation (including the complete upgrade of our old asbestos-backed switchboard which also became necessary) were readily provided and explained, as were system design suggestions/options to best suit our particular needs and situation.  All work was carried out by a very courteous, punctual, well-presented and totally professional crew, who were a credit to the business. There has also been prompt follow-ups in relation to metering and system performance.  The augmentation involved adding another separate string comprised of a Sungrow SH5.0RS hybrid inverter, Trina Vertex S+ 440w panels (1.76kW) with additional cabling for future expansion and a Sungrow SBR096 battery. Total system size now 6.66kW. Everything is working to specification and we are especially pleased with amount of visibility we now have of our power utilisation, that monitoring for all PV (both old and new) is handled efficiently by a single Sungrow app, having a backup capability and a future-proofed outcome.  Grid connection and all other grid-related issues were dealt with by the installer.P.S.  HOTT's belief in retaining and simply augmenting our existing system was an unprompted confirmation of a similar recommendation provided in prior exchanges we had with Anthony and Kim of SoarQuotes!
Great service from start to finish very happy with the results

We were impressed with HottElectrics from quote to install and clean up. They are a punctual and polite well drilled team that have a passion for solar and the related products and services they deliver.We were impressed with their attention to detail in quoting and the final workmanship of the installation.
The whole exercise was average, but a good learning curve

James was the only one to visit my home to get my specific wants and needs which I valued highly.The install was done neatly and needed a second day to finish off the software config on the battery and inverter.While not the cheapest the brands used and work done were of good quality.

The whole experience was outstanding.  Clear information, great advice, knew about other requirements including roof tiles and removal of old aerial.  Installation guys were excellent and post installation follow up was very useful too.

Quote process was outstanding.  Sales person did some videos to explain the process and costs and provided a number of options.  The installation team were prompt and did exactly what they said they would do.  And since install 6 months ago, their customer service for minor issues (with monitoring only - no issues with actual solar supply) is perfect.  Thanks team.
Done everything for me had to change from Origin but due to would of taken longer to get installed

Scott and the team at HOTT Electrics did a fantastic job installing my solar. Really nice down to earth guys and easy to deal with in all aspects. James and Scott spent a lot of time with me on the design and quoting, and explained all aspects of the system and the installation clearly. Many other strictly solar companies sent out sales reps that weren't able to answer all my detailed questions on the installation and electrical work that was needed.Their installation was very neat and tidy, and worked with me to accommodate where I wanted everything mounted and where/how the cabling was to be run throughout the house. Highly recommended.

Hott did a great job going through our electricity bill and consumption as well as explainjng the different solar options. The quote received was well detailed and explained. The installation was very well done and looks good. Timely and great customer service overall.
I did the organising the grid connection myself ( I presume that is the smart meter.)

Scott and his crew were top notch for three electrical upgrades to put home in the northern suburbs of Wollongong. The on site inspections of our needs and the suggestions made and the quoting process, we’re professional and easy to understand. Their explanations of the benefit of quality solar panels, what to expect from the electric retailers and way to extract maximum benefit were clear and easy to follow. They were the best of our three quotes by a clear margin.The installation of our solar panels, heat pump hot water system and split system air conditioner were just fine. Minimal disruption, no fuss and clear advice on how to use our new systems to best advantage were clear and very useful. They even moved the passive heating system for our pool, to the other side of the house, so that the solar panels were most effective. Impressive.They organised our connection to the grid with us and helped us to get a better deal from our supplier. After work service has been good too.So we are happy campers and would commend Hott Electrics to anyone seeking quality electrical contractors.

It was great to talk face to face and not a sales rep on the phone, Hott Electrics customer service was professional and informative, their installation team were punctual, polite and tidy, they even replaced an existing broken tile which was extremely appreciated by us. Above all, they are a local company and we feel very confident that should any problems arise in the future we will be able to contact them to have it resolved.

Very punctual professional and friendly. Communication was great, installation was on time and staff were happy to answer all questions and didn't rush when explaining the system to me. Would recommend this company to friends and family.

Scott and his team from Hoot have been doing all our electrical instillation on our new house after the handover 5yrs ago. So it was a no brainer to get them to quote on a battery system and extra panels when we decided to finally go down that path. Scott's go to man for solar is Sam, and his customer service and knowledge of such sytems is second to none.Once we decided on the correct system to buddy up on our current solar and a price was agreed on and the deposit paid we had the team at our place 10 days later.The culture that Scott has in place with his team is very evident. The boys were there first thing in the morning and by 4pm the job was complete. This also included adding some extra electrical items for outside and the main bathroom.Unfortunaly through no fault of their own, a software issue meant that they had to return the next day to carry out a Blackout procedure to test the sytem. But apart fromn that it went as smoothly as clockwork. The new battery and extra panels are working perfectly as well as the other items installed. I highly recommend HOOT for all electrical work and solar instillation.

HOTT electrics is not just a solar installer, they are master electricians who are knowledgeable and professional.  They give you opinions about how to maximize your panel efficiency when designing your system.  They also respond to you very quickly if you have any questions.  In short, the whole installation process was smooth and pleasant.

Hott electrics installed a 9.3 kW Solar System at my house.We were very happy with the whole process. They provided various "options and good technical advice. The installation team were very professional and on time.I would not hesitate to recommend them for a solar installation.

Installed my new solar system amongst other electrical work. Solar Experts , very knowledgeable and a great team to work with. Would rather go with a trusted local electrician where my warranty wont disappear a couple years later unlike the 'marketed' solar companies out there. Very fairly prices for all the quality work they have done for me.
It's too early to comment about the product but the team seems to know what they are doing which is peace of mind when spending that much money.
